Junior Software Developer 💰 Salary: $60,000 - 90,000 per year

At EAi Technologies we are looking for a JavaScript engineer!

🛠️ Our tech stack:
JavaScript, Mobile, NoSQL, SQL, Security, Web

📝 Rquirements:
- Fundamentals in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Engineering
- Proficient in or capable of swiftly learning JavaScript, APIs, SQL/NoSQL, and emerging technologies
- High Energy and Positive Attitude
- Strong Creative Problem-Solving Skills

👩‍💻👨‍💻 Your responsibilities are:
- Design and create dynamic web and mobile applications in areas such as Cyber Security, Supply Chain/Logistics, and Finance
- Collaborate with small teams to serve a variety of clients including Verizon, Capital One, and Cardinal Health
- Engage in a fast-paced, hands-on client-facing role
- Witness the direct impact of your contributions on a daily basis

View this job and over 500 other transparent jobs with salaries (💰💰💰) & tech stacks (🛠️) on DevITJobs

Category: JavaScript Developer / Engineer
Location address: Old Gallows Road 1945, Arlington, United States

Salary: $60,000 - 90,000 per year

Benefits & perks that we offer:

EAi Technologies - More about us and the role:
At EAI, we foster a sense of camaraderie and family while challenging you technically to grow. We provide our EAI Family with daily complimentary catered lunches, a weekly stipend during remote work, and free snacks and beverages. Our benefits include paid training opportunities through platforms like CodeAcademy and Coursera, as well as mentoring. Since our inception in 2001, we have never laid off employees, supporting our team through multiple economic challenges. We are expanding and seek passionate individuals to join our dynamic and accomplished team, enjoying activities like Hackathons, Poker nights, and Movie nights. Experience the welcoming and family-oriented atmosphere that keeps our team together for years.
